A food item which restores {{Energy|+|24}} when consumed.  Since all the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}s lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].

Arguably best food in game by cost/effectiveness ratio. It could be mass-produced, unlike food with high quality ingredients, it is relatively cheap, but has relatively high energy value.
